name: power-apps-canvas-ship
description: Push and publish Power Apps canvas app changes through FlowStudio MCP, and get out of trouble: refused pushes, apps that call flows, damaged drafts and Power Apps Studio saving over your work. Load this skill when asked to: push or publish canvas app changes, recover from a push refused because the app moved, fix a push that fails on a deleted flow, spot a damaged draft or restore a good version, or work alongside an open Power Apps Studio session. Requires a FlowStudio MCP subscription; see https://mcp.flowstudio.app
